mcp.docs
  Kind     MCP server
  Adds     Search the documentation.
  Agents   every selected agent that supports it
  Domains  every domain
  State    local value on this machine

mcp.issues
  Kind     MCP server
  Adds     Read work issues.
  Agents   every selected agent that supports it
  Domains  work
  State    not in domain personal

skills.notes
  Kind     Skill
  Adds     Skill folder .agents/skills/notes
  Agents   every selected agent that supports it
  Domains  every domain
  State    on

mcp.review-docs
  Kind     MCP server
  Source   marketplace agent-market/review-kit
  Adds     Search review guides.
  Agents   every selected agent that supports it
  Domains  every domain
  State    on

Change: fleet agents set --name ITEM --state on, off, or local
